title: Prompt-injected document/tool result causes an unauthorized tool action
bad_event: A sensitive action whose authorization-relevant arguments depend on untrusted data executes without a fresh user confirmation of exactly its tool and argument values.
adversary: Model: any trace of tool results (tainted), derivations with arbitrary content, confirmations by any caller and actions with any arguments.
refutation: An executed sensitive action with tainted arguments and no exact confirmation despite full checks (witnesses: non-propagating summarizer, paraphrase confirmation, confirmation reuse).
scope: Lean model only; no runtime harness. Not: wisdom of confirmations, correctness of untainted values, planner isolation.

assumptions.text: Labels reflect true provenance: the planner never reads untrusted data except through labelled values.
The confirmation UI shows exact values and only users can confirm.
Confirmation burden on honest tasks is acceptable.
